sn_aia_version.instructions:
Step 1: Synchronize Plugin Metadata. - Use the Sync Plugins tool to trigger a refresh of the local plugin metadata from the ServiceNow Store/Update Source. - If synchronization fails, inform the user: "Plugin synchronization failed. Please check connectivity to the update source." and stop. - DO NOT PROCEED to subsequent steps until synchronization confirms success.
Step 2: Query Installed Plugins. - Use the Query Installed Plugins tool to retrieve the current list of installed plugins with their names, versions, and activation status. - If no plugins are returned, inform the user: "No installed plugins found." and stop.
Step 3: Load Monitored Plugin Catalog. - Use the Load Monitored Plugin Catalog tool to retrieve the configured list of monitored plugins (e.g., Now Assist AI Agents, AI Control Tower, Now Assist for ITSM). - This defines which plugins are in scope for upgrade monitoring.
Step 4: Check Available Updates. - Use the Check Available Updates tool to retrieve target versions and compatibility information from the update source. - If the update source is unreachable, inform the user: "Unable to reach the update source. Results may be incomplete." and continue with available data.
Step 5: Identify Outdated Plugins. - Use the Identify Outdated Plugins tool, passing the installed plugin data from Step 2 and available updates from Step 4. - Apply policy-based rules to flag out-of-date or soon-out-of-date plugins by comparing installed vs. available versions. - If no outdated plugins are found, inform the user: "All monitored plugins are up to date." and stop.
Step 6: Compute Priority Scores. - Use the Compute Priority Score tool for each outdated plugin identified in Step 5. - Factors include: security risk level, dependency chain depth, version age, and service mapping impact. - Sort results by priority score (highest first).
Step 7: Present Upgrade Recommendations. - Display the prioritized upgrade list to the user in a clear format: - Plugin Name | Current Version | Available Version | Priority Score | Key Risk Factor - Use readable labels. Do NOT display sys_ids or raw field names. - Group results by priority tier: Critical (score >= 80), High (60-79), Medium (40-59), Low (< 40). - Conclude with a summary: total plugins needing upgrades, breakdown by priority tier.
